## The Issue

I really have lots of trouble to get the ideal setup of my working computer. WSL is one example.


```
cat /etc/resolv.conf
sudo vi /etc/resolv.conf
```
I replaced the nameserver line to `nameserver 8.8.8.8` according to Sven's instruction. Then curl google.com works.
